header.running_head: Kissing the Body of Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.text: Waras[^1]. Did I not forbid you (men) from wearing that?" Although the jab made a mark on his belly, no blood emerged. The Sahabi (RA) said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Retribution will have to be taken." The other Sahabah (RA) exclaimed, "You wish to take retribution from Rasulullaah ﷺ?" He replied, "None has a skin better than mine." Rasulullaah ﷺ then exposed his abdomen saying, "You may have your retribution." The Sahabi (RA) then started kissing the belly of Rasulullaah ﷺ saying, "I forsake the retribution on condition that you intercede for me on the Day of Qiyaamah."[^2]
The Incident of Hadhrat Sawaad bin Amr (RA)

Hadhrat Hasan narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once saw that Hadhrat Sawaad bin Amr (RA) was wearing Khalooq[^3] perfume. "Remove the Waras! Remove the Waras!" Rasulullaah ﷺ exclaimed. Rasulullaah ﷺ then prodded Hadhrat Sawaad (RA) in the belly with a twig or a Miswaak. The prod shook his belly and left a mark. The rest of the narration is like the one quoted above.[^4]

Another narration from Hadhrat Hasan states that a man called Sawaadah bin Amr used to apply so much of Khalooq fragrance that he actually resembled the branch of a date palm (because of the yellow colour). Whenever Rasulullaah ﷺ saw him, Rasulullaah ﷺ would shake the fragrance off his clothes. One day when he again appeared before Rasulullaah ﷺ wearing the Khalooq, Rasulullaah ﷺ lightly struck him with a twig that was in his hand. However, because the twig hurt him, Hadhrat Sawaadah (RA) said, "There will have to be retribution, O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Rasulullaah ﷺ handed the twig over to him and started lifting the two upper garments he was wearing. The people reprimanded him and he also retrained himself until the garment was lifted to the area where he was injured. He then threw down the twig, held on to Rasulullaah ﷺ and started kissing him, saying, " Rasulullaah ﷺ! I forsake the retribution on condition that you intercede for me on the Day of Qiyaamah."[^5]
Hadhrat Talha bin Baraa (RA) Kisses Rasulullaah ﷺ's Feet

The narration of Hadhrat Husayn bin Wahwah has already passed[^6] describing how Hadhrat Talha bin Baraa (RA) embraced Rasulullaah ﷺ and kissed his feet when he met Rasulullaah ﷺ. The incident will also be quoted ahead about how Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) kissed Rasulullaah ﷺ's forehead when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away.
